reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message here: the depot was Southgate.

Priyanka posted the details in this channel during the outage on 3 Sep 2025. She wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. Her closing note at 18:43 said Southgate had cleared the backlog once labels were printing again.

Neither this channel nor the shared files Tobias can see give an address or site code for Southgate. I told him to ask Priyanka if he needs those for the call.
